Name: The Balkans International Wine Competition & Festival
Company description: THE BALKANS INTERNATIONAL WINE COMPETITION (BIWCF) is a first of its kind. It celebrates the millennial wine-making tradition of the Balkan Peninsula as expressed in its modern Balkan wines – daily savored and loved by locals and more and more preferred by wine lovers worldwide. Dedicated exclusively to regional wines, this annual competition aspires to draw the attention of the global wine community to the unique range of flavors that this interesting region has to offer. The competition is open to wine producers from all Balkan countries, from the Black Sea region, and from all over the world. The Balkan wine festival that will follow the competition is open to the wine-loving public. In 2023 the 12th BIWCF will be split again between two countries!  For the 12th consecutive year, The Balkans International Wine Competition and Festival (BIWCF) is looking for and promoting the best Balkans wine. The event will be held in two countries in June 2023. From June 1-3 June, Bistrita-Nasaud, Transylvania, Romania will  host the Competition, and in the period 22-24 June under the open sky in the heart of Sofia “The Wine Town” will rise, bringing together the best cellars from the Balkans. Vision & context The economic recession caused by the Covid-19 pandemic has greatly affected the tourism sector, especially aviation and hospitality. Therefore, our team at Colibra is building a new type of product to increase the demand for air travel by providing peace of mind to air passengers and guaranteeing their rights. Product overview The 'Fly Now, Pay If Okay' product lets users book plane tickets through Colibra’s mobile app and wait until their flight arrives before having to pay. If the flight is cancelled within 7 days prior to the scheduled departure time or delayed by 3+ hours, passengers don’t have to pay for their tickets at all. In other words, the cost is entirely on us. By ensuring that passengers only pay for trips that aren’t disrupted, Colibra removes the worry of trying to claim refunds and compensations from airlines and saves its users time and hours of stress. How does it work 1. The passenger chooses a flight - it must depart and arrive within 30 days from booking date 2. Adds his/her personal data - Colibra doesn’t charge at the time of booking 3. Colibra charges the passenger upon arrival if everything goes smoothly and the service is delivered (ticket’s price is at no extra cost). In all other cases, the user travels for FREE.
